manufacturer_site.description: Exact factory/site and approved process owner; a corporate brochure is not project approval.

project_stackup_revision.description: Project-specific signed stackup identifier and revision.

finished_board_thickness_mm.description: Nominal finished thickness; do not inherit the old 1.6 mm.

finished_board_thickness_tolerance_mm.description: Finished thickness tolerance and measurement convention.

mechanical_thickness_approval.description: Connector, keepout, assembly and enclosure approval of thickness.

material_systems.description: Laminate/prepreg vendors, exact grades, resin/glass styles and press construction.

copper_layers.description: 24 layer records with base/finished copper thickness, plating and roughness.

dielectric_gaps.description: 23 cured gap records with core/prepreg, thickness/tolerance and frequency-dependent Dk/Df.

symmetric_construction_tolerances.description: Permitted mirrored copper/dielectric deviations and copper-balance rules.

material_frequency_data_and_models.description: Dk/Df extraction conditions, roughness model and frequency-dependent solver data.

lamination_sequence.description: Actual subassemblies, drill/plate/fill steps, buildup count per side and sequence; 2+20+2 is only a candidate.

trace_space_limits.description: Layer/process-specific finished widths, clearances, etch tolerances and cap-plating restrictions.

layer_registration_tolerance_um.description: Registration for each relevant drilling/lamination process.

approved_via_macros.description: Whole interconnect macro geometries and process sequences, not just individual hole layer pairs.

microvia_geometry.description: Laser entry/target diameter, capture/target pad, depth, taper, aspect ratio convention and limit.

microvia_fill_and_cap.description: Copper fill, planarization, cap plating, wrap, dimple and void/reliability limits.

microvia_stacking_limits.description: Approved stacked stages, permitted landing types, and prohibition/permission of microvia-on-core-via.

staggered_microvia_clearance.description: Center/edge clearance definitions, minimum offsets and lateral landing bridge rules.

signal_landing_on_ground_layer.description: L2/L23 isolated signal landing and local bridge geometry, antipad, registration and reference-plane damage limits.

mechanical_drill_geometry.description: Tool vs finished hole sizes, annular requirements, aspect ratios, padstack and antipad clearances.

buried_core_via_options.description: Approved core layer spans and plating/fill process; no arbitrary internal end layers.

backdrill_process.description: Sides, drill diameters, target/stop conventions, depth tolerance, maximum residual stub and copper keepout.

core_backdrill_capability.description: Whether core-level backdrill exists; process and tolerances if used, explicitly not assumed.

via_in_pad_assembly_rules.description: VIPPO/copper filled microvia requirements, solder finish, dimple/void criteria and stencil implications.

reliability_acceptance.description: IPC class, coupon structures, electrical reflow/thermal tests and project acceptance evidence.

bareboard_test_plan.description: Electrical netlist testing, impedance/coupon measurements, inspection and traceability.

component_ballmaps_and_pdg.description: Real CPU/switch/connector pinouts, footprints, escape guidance, validated sources and revisions.

interface_net_classification.description: Verified high-speed pairs, clock/sensitive analog/PDN nets and P/N membership; name inference is insufficient.

impedance_profiles.description: Per-interface/per-layer impedance targets, finished W/S/T/H, tolerance and solver/coupon evidence.

broadside_coupling_envelopes.description: Qualified geometry/per-interface S-S spacing, cross-layer lateral offset, near-parallel length and crossing limits for pairs 6/7,12/13,18/19.

signal_reference_corridors.description: Required uninterrupted reference polygon corridors and clearances from holes, edges, islands and plane splits.

return_transition_macros.description: Signal pair and GND stitching geometry connecting every old/new reference plane.

channel_acceptance_limits.description: Per-interface loss/return loss/NEXT/FEXT/mode conversion/skew/jitter/eye budgets with package/connector models.

pdn_and_thermal_limits.description: Per-net DC/current/transient/temperature constraints; 300 W is a budget, not a rating.

route_exception_registry.description: Approved bounded escape/crossing/plane-void exceptions with evidence and expiry tied to revisions.

missing_value_semantics: null or missing source/revision/approval is BLOCKED for routing qualification and release; it is never zero, unlimited, waived, or approved.
